body.purpose: Default product content and form text; body copy rises to 16px on narrow screens.

title.purpose: Clear section titles within the reseller workspace.

label.purpose: Compact, high-clarity labels for fields and controls.

action.purpose: Clear, confident label for the main task action.

compact-action.purpose: Smaller action label for secondary handoff controls.

shadows.name: shadow-card
shadows.purpose: Subtle separation for resting light-theme panels.

shadows.name: shadow-card-dark
shadows.purpose: Subtle separation for resting dark-theme panels.

motion.name: spring-snappy
motion.purpose: Responsive sidebar and emphasized transition easing.

motion.name: state-transition

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Confident action for the main task in a panel.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { background: var(--primary-900); color: #fff; padding: 13px 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; font: 600 14px/1.5 Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms, box-shadow 150ms, transform 100ms; box-shadow: var(--shadow); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-800); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: scale(.97); } .ds-button-primary:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Handoff
components.description: Moves product details to a related tool without replacing existing input.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 9px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--primary); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--primary-dark); font: 600 12.8px/1.25 Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms, color 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: var(--primary-900); color: #fff; border-color: var(--primary-900); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Recessed field with clear label and teal focus feedback.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 5px; font: 400 15px/1.5 Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { color: var(--text-soft); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1.5px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface2); color: var(--text); font: inherit; transition: border-color 150ms, background 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--primary); background: var(--surface); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(14,110,175,.1); outline: none; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Workspace Panel
components.description: Quiet bordered surface for input or results.
components.html:
Hasil analisis

Ringkasan keputusan barang tampil di sini.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: 20px 24px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface); box-shadow: var(--shadow-card); color: var(--text); } .ds-panel-title { margin: 0 0 8px; font: 700 20px/1.25 Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel-copy { margin: 0; color: var(--text-soft); font: 400 15px/1.5 Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation Item
components.description: Grouped workflow link with a distinct current-page state.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #D0DEDC; text-align: left; font: 500 13px/1.4 Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.09); color: #fff; } .ds-nav-item[aria-current="page"] { background: rgba(104,193,181,.18); color: #fff; font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--amber); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-mark { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--amber); }

components.name: Active Feature Tab
components.description: Compact selection control for switching analysis workflows.
components.css: .ds-feature-tab { padding: 5px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--primary-900); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--primary-900); color: #fff; font: 600 12px/1.4 Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 130ms, color 130ms, border-color 130ms; } .ds-feature-tab:hover { background: var(--primary-800); } .ds-feature-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-feature-tab:active { transform: scale(.96); }

components.name: Status Chip
components.css: .ds-status-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 5px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface2); color: var(--success-text); font: 600 12px/1.4 Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-status-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--success); }

narrative.overview:
ReSell AI is a distinct, dependable workbench for independent resellers. Its interface is practical and direct, with a recognizable teal-and-navy foundation and a warm amber signature. The design should feel unique and extraordinary through confident hierarchy, clear grouping, and considered interaction details, not through novelty that slows down everyday work.

The desktop experience pairs familiar category navigation with a focused input-and-result workspace. Indonesian labels, Rupiah-oriented workflows, and a responsive layout keep the interface grounded in local reseller work. Light and dark themes preserve the same hierarchy and color roles. Marketplace identities and logos are not visual references.
keyCharacteristics: A trustworthy navy frame with teal interaction cues and amber emphasis.
Clear, information-dense panels designed for repeated operational use.
Direct Indonesian copy and predictable controls across desktop and mobile.

rules.name: The Role-First Color Rule
rules.body: Color indicates hierarchy or state. Keep amber selective, and do not rely on color alone to communicate status.

rules.name: The Scan-First Type Rule
rules.body: Keep field labels and actions explicit; avoid decorative display treatments that compete with product data.

rules.name: The Surface-First Depth Rule
rules.body: Prefer tonal surface shifts and borders; reserve shadows for meaningful hierarchy.

dos: Do keep product actions and field labels in clear, concise Indonesian.
Do use navy for dependable structure, teal for interaction, and amber as a selective brand accent.
Do preserve the light/dark role mapping and the mobile one-column workflow.
Do maintain readable text, visible focus, and minimum 44px touch targets.
Do keep product handoff non-destructive by filling only blank destination fields.
donts: Don't imitate the visual identity, logo, or signature palette of any marketplace.
Don't use amber as a large-area background or as the default color for every action.
Don't add decorative gradients, excessive shadows, or motion that obscures product data.
Don't communicate status through color alone or reduce keyboard focus visibility.
